steps.say: An application can answer questions from a document collection. This collection holds 13 World Bank economic updates on Kenya and Uganda.
steps.speak: An application can answer questions from a document collection. This collection holds thirteen World Bank economic updates on Kenya and Uganda.

steps.say: Together the reports have 769 pages of text, tables and charts.
steps.speak: Together the reports have seven hundred and sixty-nine pages of text, tables and charts.

steps.say: Retrieval-augmented generation, or RAG, first prepares the collection, once, before any question.
steps.speak: Retrieval-augmented generation, or rag, first prepares the collection, once, before any question.

steps.say: The application divides each page into short passages. Each passage keeps its report, its edition date and its page.
An embedding model turns each passage into a vector, a list of numbers that represents its meaning.
The passages and their vectors go into a store, 3,440 passages for this collection.
steps.speak: The passages and their vectors go into a store, three thousand, four hundred and forty passages for this collection.

steps.say: The second stage runs for each question. A user asks how much Uganda's economy grew in FY25.
steps.speak: The second stage runs for each question. A user asks how much Uganda's economy grew in F Y twenty-five.

steps.say: The same embedding model turns the question into a vector.
The search compares this vector with the vectors in the store and returns the three passages closest in meaning.
The application builds a prompt from the instructions, these passages and the question.
A language model writes the answer from the prompt, with a citation to a report and a page after each figure.
The answer gives growth of 6.3 percent for FY25.
steps.speak: The answer gives growth of six point three percent for F Y twenty-five.

steps.say: Its citation leads to page 12 of the December 2025 Uganda Economic Update.
steps.speak: Its citation leads to page twelve of the December twenty twenty-five Uganda Economic Update.

steps.say: A reader can check the figure against the text of the report.
